commentary_title: Atlantic weakness weighs on Panamax rates
commentary_summary: Panamax rates softened over the week, with Atlantic demand remaining the main weakness, as limited fresh cargo enquiry weighed on transatlantic and fronthaul rates. | Congestion at both load and discharge ports has declined across most regions, except in the Indian Ocean. Lower congestion has released vessels back into the market, adding to available tonnage and putting pressure on charter rates. | The Pacific remains relatively better supported, with Australian cargoes and Asian coal demand providing employment, although this has not been sufficient to offset the weakness in the Atlantic.
